claim: If a message with a particular deduplication ID is successfully published to an SNS FIFO topic, any message published with the same deduplication ID within the five minute deduplication interval is accepted but not delivered. Deduplication applies to the entire topic when FifoThroughputScope is set to Topic, and to each individual message group when it is set to MessageGroup.

qualifiers.scope: per SNS FIFO topic (FifoThroughputScope Topic) or per message group (MessageGroup); per deduplication ID

evidence.quote: If a message with a particular deduplication ID is successfully published to an Amazon SNS FIFO topic, any message published with the same deduplication ID, within the five minute deduplication interval, is accepted but not delivered.

Message deduplication applies to an entire Amazon SNS FIFO topic when the topic attribute FifoThroughputScope is set to Topic. When the topic attribute FifoThroughputScope is set to MessageGroup, message deduplication applies to each individual message group.
